output.summary: Reported on-time jumped only after the dispatcher bonus took effect, staggered by center: Northgate and Riverside in March, Pell Junction in July once eligible. RouteWise timing doesn't match, since Pell Junction went live in February with no gain and Northgate rose before its October go-live. Revisions rose 5x, driven by capacity reason codes, entered late, with few customers notified. The largest customer's dock logs show 81% on time against original dates, down from 87%, versus a 98.4% scorecard. Complaints rose before the portal launched, while other categories were flat. Driver vacancy is only loosely correlated and unadjusted. Do not advertise or raise the bonus. Recompute against original dates and re-base the incentive.
